It is distinct from native HTTP finished success. Source-proven absence of later fixture writes is required, not merely a generic successful readback.
terminal_contract.TERMINAL_FAILURE: An actual authoritative backend rejection/rollback result with its full operation settled may be terminal failure; RequestFailed/ERR_ABORTED, a local unavailable mapping, missing rows or JavaScript rejection are not such proof. Current transport-uncertain/uncommitted attempts remain UNKNOWN, not assumed rolled back.
terminal_contract.UNKNOWN: No exact attributable commit certificate, mismatched action/request/attempt/revision, unobserved extra request, pending readback/fault/body work, cancellation without server outcome, or uncertain cleanup => retain custody and propagate failure.
terminal_contract.scope_limit: A commit certificate for one manage call does not settle another call, anonymous fetch counters, fault-route handlers, auth/setup, late operations, global key consumers or other fixtures.
